scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Word Games Championship! Six rounds, two teams, one dictionary as the judge. May the best spellers win!

activities.title: Words about words! Read and write.

words.clue: The book where all the words live, from A to Z.
Saying a word letter by letter: C-A-T.
All the letters in order, from A to Z.
A, E, I, O or U.
When two words end with the same sound, like cat and hat.
Hot and cold, big and small — they are this.

activities.title: Listen to the championship. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (árbitro) y Oliver (capitán del equipo Puffins).
data.script: Ingrid: Round one: spelling! Team Puffins, spell the word LIGHTHOUSE. … Oliver: L-I-G-H-T-H-O-U-S-E. Lighthouse! … Ingrid: Correct! Ten points. Round two: find a rhyme for GUITAR. … Oliver: Star! A star for my guitar! … Ingrid: Round three: the opposite of ANCIENT. … Oliver: Modern! … Ingrid: Round four: how many vowels are in the word EDUCATION? … Oliver: E-U-A-I-O… five! … Ingrid: Amazing! Final score: Puffins ninety, Dolphins eighty-five. … Oliver: We won by five points! Kili, bring the trophy!

data.text: Mini championship: 3 rounds against your partner — spell a word, find a rhyme, say an opposite. Use words from any unit of this book. Keep score!

activities.title: Look at A and B. What is different?

homework.prompt: Invent a word game for the class: write its 3 rules in English. The best game will be played on Friday!
